snippet.title: MIMESIS Early Access Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
We are finally HERE! 
STEAM PAGE : https://bit.ly/4o4SP8J

MIMESIS Early Access begins on October 27th.

A new experience where I deceive myself. Are you ready to enjoy it? 

4 Player co-op survival horror game. When the cursed rain falls, 'Mimesis' appear, perfectly imitating your teammates, bringing a new level of tension you've never experienced before.
